verdict: No scientific or apparatus blocker to packaging this proposed chemical-route readout. This is prototype approval only; final task, data, grading and agent difficulty remain unreviewed.
findings: The column generator sums both elementary routes with correct forward/reverse state indices, and its stationary distribution is normalized. The conformation dynamics of the aggregate chain are exact.

The regeneration readout is chemical free-energy work at fixed temperature, not bare heat. One forward route consumes its specified fuel; reverse conversion returns it. The supplied work is the signed channel current times that reservoir chemical-potential difference. Negative local route currents are allowed.

Local detailed balance is log(k_forward/k_reverse)=A-(E_next-E). At stationarity, energy and Shannon-entropy differences telescope. Thus route-resolved entropy production equals the measured chemical work in kBT=1 units. Summing routes before the logarithm instead gives the mathematically valid aggregate-chain entropy production and loses reservoir identity.

For each edge the missed term is F*KL(f/F||b/B)+B*KL(b/B||f/F). It is nonnegative and vanishes for equal channel affinities. The closure is a physical effective-reservoir approximation, not a defective stationary-state solve or an arbitrary missing summand.

Equal-affinity calibration has both routes active and nonzero power. The revised 18 settings vary total barriers rather than merely swapping route labels. A common rate scale leaves stationary probabilities unchanged and scales all powers, making the positive-scale least-squares fit globally identifiable.

The independent characteristic generator marks signed fuel work on off-diagonal route jumps and leaves escape diagonals untilted. Its eigenvalue continuing zero has imaginary first derivative equal to the work rate. This construction does not reuse the stationary probability solve or aggregate affinity.

The proposed input fixes stoichiometry, local rates, temperature, distinct reservoirs, stationary preparation and reversible regeneration measurement. It supplies no readout correction formula or numerical-method mandate. The stated ideal kinetic rates define the model without unspecified reaction intermediates.

The report consistently treats 1024 corners and random interior checks as numerical evidence, not proof of a continuum-wide minimum gap. Both true and aggregate signals are bounded away from zero on the sampled diagnostic subset.
qualifications: Material overlap with Floquet thermalization r2 is real: both retain exact state dynamics while losing transition-channel thermodynamics. The chemical apparatus and aggregate-entropy closure differ; this is not an unrelated general principle or a novelty claim.
